base.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        require(not base.stat().st_mode & 0o077,
                "private record directory must have mode 0700: " + str(base))
        name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())

        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
evidence.reason: claim_run_dir creates the record base and the new run directory with mkdir (lines 606-612) but never fsyncs the base directory entry before returning/admission. durable_write(path in run_dir) can sync the receipt and run_dir, but that does not persist the new child entry in base (or base's own parent if base was just created). A crash can therefore lose the entire run directory while the host remains held, destroying the prior-SHA/trigger recovery evidence. The fix is to fsync base after mkdir, fsync the parent when base was newly created, and refuse admission if either sync fails.
